system.description:
Fortitude Amp

Your back is against the wall and you need to focus, going beyond what your limits suggest;

Uncapped Strength. You gain a +2 bonus to damage you deal. This increases to +4 at 11th level.

Broken Limits. Once per turn on your turn, you can spend 3 Drive, spending your Bonus Action, to gain an Action.

Always Push Forward. You gain advantage on saving throws and checks to resist being Grappled, Restrained, Stunned, Staggered having your speed reduced by hostile effects.

Stress. At the end of each of your turns, make a Constitution ability check vs a DC 20. On a success, you persist in this state and it doesn’t end. On a failure, this state ends.
system.summary: +2 damage (+4 at 11th), Drive for an extra Action, and advantage to resist grapples, restraints, stuns and Staggered. A DC 20 Con check each turn keeps it going.

rules.text: Starts the first time you fall below half your hit or chakra points.
Stress: at the end of each of your turns, a DC 20 Constitution check; on a failure it ends.
